channel.title: House of Jewelux Blog
channel.description: Jewellery care, style guides and stories of Indian craft from the House of Jewelux atelier in Jaipur.

item.title: How to Care for Sterling Silver Jewellery at Home
item.description: Why silver darkens, how to clean it gently with things you already have, and the simple habits that keep your pieces bright for years.

item.title: How to Find Your Ring Size at Home
item.description: Three reliable ways to measure your ring size without visiting a store, the common mistakes to avoid, and what to do when you are buying a ring as a surprise.

item.title: Temple Jewellery: The Story Behind South India's Sacred Ornaments
item.description: Where temple jewellery comes from, the motifs you will see again and again, how it is made, and how to wear it today without losing its sense of ceremony.

item.title: Layering Necklaces: A Simple Guide for Every Neckline
item.description: How to combine chains and pendants so they look effortless rather than tangled, with lengths, spacing and neckline pairings that work every time.

item.title: Polki, Kundan and Meenakari: Three Indian Techniques Explained
item.description: The differences between three of India's best-known jewellery techniques, how each one is made, how to recognise them, and how to care for them.

item.title: Gemstone Care: Keeping Emeralds, Rubies, Sapphires and Pearls at Their Best
item.description: Every gemstone has its own needs. A practical guide to cleaning, wearing and storing the stones you are most likely to own, and the mistakes that cause lasting damage.
